description: This source file provides utility functions for processing plugin metadata, including rewriting package extensions, collecting plugin files, copying plugin skills, and managing plugin distribution. It includes functions for path resolution, error handling, and filesystem operations related to plugin packaging and distribution.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites extension entries by normalizing and replacing file extensions with .js.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects significant top-level files (excluding test and config files) from a plugin directory.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a runtime support package without a manifest based on its name and public surface entries.

methods.name: rewritePackageEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a package entry path and replaces its extension with .js.

methods.name: ensurePathInsideRoot
methods.description: Resolves a path inside a root directory, ensuring it does not escape outside.

methods.name: normalizeManifestRelativePath
methods.description: Normalizes a raw path to a consistent format with forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path of a declared plugin skill within the plugin or repository root.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Generates the output path for a bundled skill, handling node_modules paths specially.

methods.name: isTransientCopyError
methods.description: Checks whether an error is a transient filesystem error that warrants a retry.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Performs a synchronous sleep for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: copySkillPathWithRetry
methods.description: Copies a folder from source to target with retry logic on transient errors.

methods.name: copyDeclaredPluginSkillPaths
methods.description: Copies declared plugin skills from source to distribution directory, handling nested node_modules.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main function to process plugin directories, copy skills, and generate bundled metadata for plugins.
